(BY SRI. THEJESH P., HCGP FOR R1  R2 SERVED BUT UNREPRESENTED)
 -2-  NC: 2025:KHC:5932  CRL.P No. 8301 of 2023

THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 482 CR.P.C PRAYING TO QUASH THE ENTIRE PROCEEDINGS IN C.C.NO.953/2018 ON THE FILE OF PRINCIPAL CIVIL JUDGE AND J.M.F.C., HOSAKOTE, BENGALURU RURAL DISTRICT, BENGALURU FOR THE OFFENCE PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTION 504, 498A R/W 34 OF IPC AGAINST THE PETITIONER.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER

In this petition, petitioner seeks for the following reliefs:
"Wherefore, it is prayed that this Honb'le Court be pleased to pass an order, quashing the entire proceedings in C.C.953/2018 on the file of Principal Civil Judge and JMFC,
Hoskote, Bengaluru Rural, Bengaluru for the offences punishable under Sections 504, 498 (A) read with Section 34 of IPC against the petitioner, in the above petition,
in the interest of justice."
2.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned HCGP for respondent No.1 and perused the material on record.

3. A perusal of the material on record will indicate that respondent No.2-complainant filed the instant complaint against the petitioner/accused No.1 and others for alleged offences punishable under Section 498A, 504 read with Section 34 of IPC, pursuant to NC: 2025:KHC:5932 which the impugned charge sheet in C.C.No.953/2018 was filed and the same is pending before the Sessions Court.
4. In the meanwhile, the petitioner filed petition in MC No.36/2019 which culminated for a decree for divorce dated 21.12.2019.

In addition thereto, application filed by the petitioner's parents and younger brother who are arraigned as accused Nos.2 to 4 which culminated in order dated 05.06.2020 in C.C.No.953/2018 quashing the proceedings.
However, application for discharge filed by the petitioner having been rejected by the trial Court, the petitioner is before this Court by way of the present petition.

opennyai_summary.decision:
In this petition, petitioner seeks for the following reliefs:
"Wherefore, it is prayed that this Honb'le Court be pleased to pass an order, quashing the entire proceedings in C.C.953/2018 on the file of Principal Civil Judge and JMFC,
Hoskote, Bengaluru Rural, Bengaluru for the offences punishable under Sections 504, 498 (A) read with Section 34 of IPC against the petitioner, in the above petition,
in the interest of justice."
2.
3. A perusal of the material on record will indicate that respondent No.2-complainant filed the instant complaint against the petitioner/accused No.1 and others for alleged offences punishable under Section 498A, 504 read with Section 34 of IPC, pursuant to NC: 2025:KHC:5932 which the impugned charge sheet in C.C.No.953/2018 was filed and the same is pending before the Sessions Court.
In addition thereto, application filed by the petitioner's parents and younger brother who are arraigned as accused Nos.2 to 4 which culminated in order dated 05.06.2020 in C.C.No.953/2018 quashing the proceedings.
However, application for discharge filed by the petitioner having been rejected by the trial Court, the petitioner is before this Court by way of the present petition.
In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, in particular, the discharge of accused Nos.2 to 4 as well as dissolution of marriage between the petitioner and respondent No.2 is sufficient to come to conclusion that no useful purpose would be served in continuing the proceedings especially when respondent No.2 has chosen to remain absent and has not contested the proceedings.
In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The petition is hereby allowed.
ii) The entire impugned proceedings in C.C.No.953/2018 on the file of the Principal Civil Judge and JMFC, Hoskote, Bengaluru Rural, Bengaluru for the offences punishable under Sections 504, 498 (A) read with Section 34 of IPC insofar as the petitioner is concerned, are hereby quashed.
